experimental.optIntoFeaturesThatAre: Opt into features that are still being evaluated before they become default behavior.
experimental.experimentalFeaturesMayBreakAt: Experimental features may break at any time.
experimental.theseFeaturesAreOptIn: These features are opt-in and come with no compatibility guarantees. They may change, break, or be removed without notice. Avoid relying on them for critical or production workflows.
experimental.optionalProductFeaturesThatAre: Optional product features that are still being evaluated.
experimental.talkToEachAgentIn: Talk to each agent in one ongoing conversation. Clarify goals and create tasks for execution. Chat leads the Work group and opens an agent rail beside the nav, and each chat's side panel shows the agent's tasks and artifacts as cards.
experimental.connectCodexClaudeAndOther: Connect Codex, Claude, and other assistants to your Paperclip organization. People sign in, select an organization once, and approve access to review work, delegate tasks, and add feedback.
experimental.allowAgentsToPinBeta: Allow agents to pin beta releases of the Paperclip core skill. Disabling this returns every agent to the default live skill without removing saved pins.
experimental.showPaperclipManagedBuiltIn: Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent surfaces, including built-in roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and built-in agent setup controls.
experimental.durableWorkProductsBlogPosts: Durable work products (blog posts, tweet storms…) that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.
experimental.connectAgentsToSlackDiscord: Connect agents to Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, and Telegram conversations.
experimental.foldInboxIntoTasksOne: Fold Inbox into Tasks. One Tasks row carries the unread badge, and a Views menu reaches every inbox view (Mine, Unread, Blocked, Recent, Everything) and every task view.
experimental.toggleCombinedInboxAndTask: Toggle combined inbox and task list experimental setting
experimental.addsAConferenceRoomOne: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
experimental.toggleConferenceRoomChatExperimental: Toggle conference room chat experimental setting
experimental.showTheDecisionsItemIn: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar — the attention home that surfaces the tasks awaiting your input — while the surface is still being evaluated.
experimental.showEnvironmentManagementInCompany: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.
experimental.detectExternalUrlsInIssues: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.
experimental.showExecutionWorkspaceControlsIn: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.
experimental.allowShortAcknowledgementsWhileAgents: Allow short acknowledgements while agents begin work. Configure them in Settings → Connections.
experimental.showTaskDetailControlsFor: Show task detail controls for browsing and previewing workspace files relative to a task.
experimental.firstTaskProposeWithA: First task: propose with a plan document
experimental.whenTheUserSFirst: When the user's first request is a single task, the chief of staff writes a short plan document and a checkbox card instead of a one-card confirmation. Applies to organizations created after the toggle is flipped.
experimental.toggleFirstTaskPlanProposal: Toggle first task plan proposal experimental setting
experimental.connectAgentsToGithubWith: Connect agents to GitHub with their own App identity to review pull requests and respond to issues.
experimental.toggleGithubReviewBotsExperimental: Toggle GitHub review bots experimental setting
experimental.connectAnExistingGrokBot: Connect an existing Grok Bot as an agent. Verify routine delivery and an authenticated reply before assigning work.
experimental.connectMem0ZepSupermemoryCognee: Connect Mem0, Zep, Supermemory, Cognee, and Honcho for long-term memory and context.
experimental.connectYourPersonalMetaMuse: Connect your personal Meta Muse. Pair it, detect its receiver, and verify an independent background reply before assigning tasks.
experimental.addOpenaiDotAsA: Add OpenAI Dot as a standalone agent choice. Pair your Dot and verify event delivery before assigning work.
experimental.allowAgentsToSelectPaperclip: Allow agents to select Paperclip Runner, including authenticated runner ingress when a sandbox requires it. First-run setup offers qualified GitHub Copilot. Turning this off hides the choice without affecting existing native runs.
experimental.instructAgentsToWriteUser: Instruct agents to write user interactions (plan confirmations, questions, suggested tasks, checkbox prompts) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, with brief context on what information the decision needs and what happens for each choice.
experimental.toggleSimplifiedEnglishInteractionsExper: Toggle simplified english interactions experimental setting
experimental.enableTheExperimentalSharedStatus: Enable the experimental shared status-card board and its gated API. Existing card data is kept when this is disabled.
experimental.useTheSimplifiedMainSidebar: Use the simplified main sidebar, shared Tasks and Inbox presentation, focused task detail layout, and contextual navigation across Agents, Routines, Skills, and Settings.
experimental.showSummarizerGeneratedStatusSlots: Show Summarizer-generated status slots on project and workspace pages, with on-demand refresh and revision history. Existing summary data is kept when this is disabled.
experimental.treatAProjectThatHas: Treat a project that has no execution workspace policy of its own as if it selected isolated workspaces, so its tasks get a per-task worktree instead of sharing the project checkout. A project that carries its own policy keeps it.
experimental.hideTheLocalEnvironmentAnd: Hide the local environment and run all agents in the platform-managed environment.
experimental.showInternalPaperclipMaintainerTools: Show internal Paperclip maintainer tools and observability links, including Honeycomb trace queries on run pages.
